title: Three Times a Day
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When Daniel heard the brand-new rule,
He did not hide away;
He opened up his window wide
And knelt right down to pray.

[Chorus]
Big heart, brave start, I'll kneel and pray
Like Daniel, every day;
My Father hears each word I say
And stays with me always.

[Verse 2]
The sad king could not change his rule,
So Daniel, calm and brave,
Went down where hungry lions paced;
He knew the Lord could save.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
An angel came, a shining one,
And shut each lion's jaw;
The lions lay down quiet then
And folded every paw.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
At morning light the king ran back
And called out Daniel's name;
"I'm safe!" called Daniel from the den,
"The Lord's own angel came!"

[Chorus]
mood: Kneeling music. A calm, even step under the voice, like a man crossing to his open window at the same hour every day, never hurried and never hiding. Low cello holding the floor like a big cat settling down, a light pizzicato pulse keeping the step. It opens a little brighter at the morning verse, steady and unafraid rather than triumphant.
